responsibility: This definition module exposes the generated parser entry point for mc pass 1. Its single CompilationUnit routine is the public hook used by the compilation driver to run the first parse over a source module and populate the initial declaration/module structure needed by later passes.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is only the driver-facing interface for the mcp1 parser pass, declaring CompilationUnit; unlike mcp1.bnf, it does not contain the pass-1 grammar or any semantic actions.
